rationale: Description: Kneel UPRIGHT + rotate torso fully to one side + trailing arm across body + front arm opens outward + both knees anchored. With globalTwist=+40 (torso rotates LEFT per convention), LEFT side comes forward (front arm = LEFT), RIGHT side goes back (trailing arm = RIGHT). Fixes: (1) spine 32→0 (upright per Kneel UPRIGHT); (2) shoulderFwdL=35→0 (LEFT/front arm opens outward, no forward swing); (3) shoulderFwdR=35→-50 (RIGHT/trailing arm swings FORWARD across body per corrected convention - = forward); (4) rightShoulder=-12→0 (T-pose horizontal outward); (5) globalTwist 25→40 (more torso rotation); (6) neck -10.6→0 (neutral, description does not specify head direction). Both knees anchored preserved (leftHip=rightHip=80, knees=90).
